prompt: React vs Vue: which should I learn first?

plan.title: React vs Vue: Which Should You Learn First?
plan.description: A quick answer to the React versus Vue question for beginners. Learn how to choose your first JavaScript framework based on your goal.

beats.narration: React or Vue? Stop agonizing. Both teach you the same core idea: building screens from small, reusable pieces called components.
Want the most job listings and the biggest ecosystem? Choose React. Want a gentler start with clear, friendly structure? Choose Vue.
Either way, the skills transfer. Learn one well, and the second takes days, not months. So just start building today.

props.text: Learn one well. The other comes fast.
